name: Test-point coverage per net
description: Advisory (needs a netlist): every net should have at least one probe-accessible point so ICT / flying-probe can verify it. Flags nets whose access points are all mask-covered (no exposed copper to probe). Not_applicable without a netlist or a solder-mask layer.
what_it_measures: Count of nets with no solder-mask-exposed access point (untestable by probe).
